part.text:
Set up `example.com/netapp` with `golang.org/x/net v0.59.0` and a runnable HTTP/2 (h2c) server in `main.go`. Builds and vets clean.

- `go.mod` / `go.sum` — module with `golang.org/x/net`
- `main.go` — h2c server using `golang.org/x/net/http2` and `http2/h2c`

Add websockets later via `golang.org/x/net/websocket` (already in the same dependency).
